name: Sweet, Savory, Crisp Candied Bacon

instructions.primary_message: djust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil and top with a wire rack.
In a small bowl, stir together brown sugar, black pepper, paprika, and cayenne. Arrange bacon slices on prepared rack; sprinkle evenly with sugar mixture, pressing into bacon gently to adhere.

Bake until bacon is crisp and sugar is bubbling, 20 to 25 minutes. Let cool completely on rack (bacon will firm as it cools), about 10 minutes. Serve as is or break or chop into bite-size pieces to serve.

description: This easy candied bacon recipe—sometimes called Millionaire’s Bacon—uses thick-cut slices, brown sugar, and spice for the ultimate crispy sweet-salty bite. Perfect for a festive brunch or crumbled over soup.
notes:
Notes: This recipe can easily be doubled.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 5 days. Recrisp in the oven on a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet, or in the air fryer until heated through.
author: Leah Colins
